verdict.rationale: Databricks documents querying metric views from external BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau and Sigma, which shows named BI-tool integrations. The only driver reference is a comparison that Databricks Connect embeds 'just like a JDBC driver'; the pack never explicitly documents Databricks JDBC/ODBC drivers or BI-tool connection setup. missing for 10: explicit JDBC/ODBC driver documentation, step-by-step BI-tool connection guides, independent or hands-on corroboration of dashboards connecting without custom glue.
